svg.title: 1. Hybrid reference architecture
svg.text: Data centre A, New Jersey (exits in 18 months)
Hybrid cloud on AWS: two data centres, Direct Connect at two locations, VPN backup, Transit Gateway hub
migration: removed when DC A closes
DX routes win over VPN for the
Dev and test, no path to prod
Replication over DX, private IPs only
Same Direct Connect gateway, second association.
Allowed prefixes 10.80.0.0/12. TGW peering to us-east-1
for replication. Up to 6 TGWs per DX gateway.
